review.summary: Round 3 reviews 6f0dbd8, focusing on the round 2 fixes to the F record, the runbook label table, DEPLOYMENT.md, ADR-013 and the authentication topology diagram. Round 1 F-012 and round 2 F-001 to F-005 are fixed: the rows use the labels as the table defines them, the runbook and F record label tables agree, ADR-013 and DEPLOYMENT.md point to the accepted GitHub deviations and the collaborator trigger, the admin-bypass wording is consistent and the retention decision names the main developer. An offline PlantUML 1.2026.6 render of the topology source is byte-identical to the committed SVG, every link and anchor in the changed files resolves and no forbidden data is recorded. One new low finding: the OIDC login sequence diagram, embedded next to the topology diagram, still says production setup is pending G/F. It does not block the release.
